impression: A clean, believable daylight product shot of a deep blue glossy ball on a black base and dock, with good table shadows and grain; it still reads slightly as CG because the ball is almost opaque and its reflections are a little too smooth.

acrylic.why: The ball reads as saturated tinted glass. It has crisp specular windows, some depth where the frosted inner face shows as lighter cyan at lower right, and no white-washed or milky faces. It is close to opaque, though: almost no wall or table shows through the edge, so the see-through quality is weak.

grounded.why: The dock lies flat on the table with a dark contact line and a long cast shadow to the right. The base sits inside the dock and the ball sits down in the base ring, so nothing floats.

no_light_down.why: The lamp is off. The only light on the table is warm window daylight with a shadow cast away from the sun, and there is no coloured or bright pool under or around the lamp.

todays_design.why: Every described part is there. At about 4.06 px/mm from the 160 mm ball, the dock measures about 150 mm across and roughly 8 to 10 mm thick, and the short polished black base has a matte black top ring. There is no cable and the lamp is off in daylight. The top ring looks dark grey and satin rather than clearly anodised, which is acceptable.
